description:
We are Applied Data Science & AI master's students tackling the "Flame in Freefall" challenge. Our goal is to build an AI-powered system and interactive dashboard to analyze microgravity combustion data and extract critical fire safety insights for space habitats.

Skills we bring: Python, ML/NLP pipelines, data engineering, RAG, and statistical modeling.

Looking for: UI/UX developers, frontend engineers (Streamlit/React), or anyone passionate about aerospace safety!
